definition: How many population standard deviations the latest value stands from the mean of the last window values, the latest among them.
boundaries: On whatever series it is bound to, a price or a spread; missing while the window has no spread. It says how far, not whether the value will come back.
recognition: Beyond 2 either side marks a stretched value.

class_meanings.index_cfd: A return across a session close, a weekend or a contract roll is a gap, not a bar's move; bind the statistic to bars inside one session or a back-adjusted series, or it reads the gap.
